title: Busassun, ferment da kayan abinci masu siyarwa

say: Busassun, ferment da kayan abinci masu siyarwa.
Wannan bidiyon ne don Module 4 na Babban Dafa abinci da Gina Jiki: adana abinci da samfuran fakitin.
Tsare abinci yana ba ku damar siyan kayan amfanin gona lokacin da yake da arha.

say: Kwayoyin cuta suna buƙatar ruwa don girma, don haka cire ruwa yana sa abinci ya adana tsawon watanni. Mataki na daya. A jera, wanke kuma a yanka a ko'ina, kimanin 6 zuwa 8 mm lokacin farin ciki, don haka guda ya bushe da gudu iri ɗaya.

say: Rubuta kowace dabara a matsayin kashi na jimlar nauyi, kuma kowane tsari shine kawai ninkawa. Ganyen suya na Hadiza 55% kuli kuli, busasshen chili 20%, ginger 10%, da tafarnuwa, albasa da gishiri 5% kowacce.
Ga 5,000 g tana bukatar 2,750 g na kuli kuli da 1,000 g na chilli. Ta bincika jimlar ta ƙara zuwa 5,000 g.
Kayayyakin sun kai kimanin naira 27,500, kuma fakiti da likafai kimanin naira 7,500.
Hakan ya sanya fakiti 50 na g 100, kusan naira 700 kowacce kafin lokacinta, iskar gas da riba.
Jimlar ta kai kimanin naira 35,000. Domin babban sinadarin gyada, dole ne alamarta ta bayyana rashin lafiyar gyada a fili.
A wanke kwalba a cikin ruwan zafi mai zafi, kurkure, sannan a ajiye su a cikin ruwan zãfi na tsawon minti 10 har sai kun cika su.

say: Don tunawa. A bushe a cikin busar da aka rufe kuma a yi sanyi kafin shiryawa. Jefa kowane nau'i mai laushi. Ku auna gishiri don ferments.
Rubuta dabara a cikin kashi kuma auna kowane sashi. Yi amfani da kwalabe da aka haifuwa da yiwa miya alama don sanyaya bayan buɗewa.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: bushe a cikin na'urar bushewa da aka rufe; sanyi kafin shiryawa
Batch? Yi watsi da shi duka
Yi nauyi gishiri: kusan 2% don kayan lambu mai gishiri
Rubuta dabara a cikin kashi, auna komai
Gilashin da aka haifuwa; firiji bayan budewa

say: Ayyukanku: bushe da auna samfur guda ɗaya sannan ku fitar da amfanin amfanin ku, kuyi ferment ɗaya da ƙwanƙwasa ɗaya tare da gungu na yau da kullun, sannan ku tsara, sikeli da tsadar kayan yaji ko miya.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.
